h3sed (kvit-s fork) by kvit-s
A fork of suurjaak's h3sed adding player-level editing: gold and other
resources, and which heroes are offered in taverns. Also detects the human
player from the savefile and can filter the hero list to that player's own
heroes. Opens one savegame at a time and parses heroes on demand, which makes
large savegames load faster. Supports the same game versions as h3sed.
https://github.com/kvit-s/h3sed — maintained as of 2026.
